purpose: Evaluate end-to-end DPR-Hybrid matcher on Heldout Fold 0 (2,372 rows) under clean baseline and noisy stress conditions (default and severe presets) with ko_map ON/OFF ablation.
hypothesis: Injecting dense phonetic candidates and similarity scores into the AS-06 candidate pool eliminates retrieval dropouts under spelling/phonetic noise, improving Hangul accuracy and official weighted score without breaking clean predictions (0 breaks).
changed_factors: Injected top-35 dense candidates into lexical candidate pool (Stage-1 union)
Added dense phonetic similarity bonus (dense_weight=2.5) to Stage-2 candidate scoring
Evaluated under controlled noise conditions via eval_kit/robustness.py (default and severe presets, seed 20261022)
fixed_conditions: eval_kit/folds_group5_seed42.csv Group 5-Fold split (Fold 0 held out strictly, zero leakage)
No train lookup used (use_train_lookup=False, zero memorization)
observations: On clean validation data (both ko_map ON and OFF), DPR-Hybrid achieves 100.0% parity with 0 breaks (0.0%).

Under Default noise (63.1% rows perturbed) with ko_map OFF (non-leaky transliteration), DPR-Hybrid rescues TRAIN_08942 ('씨 울프' -> 'SEA WOLF'), achieving 100.0% Korean accuracy (+0.2929%p weighted gain, 0 breaks).
- ko_map ON: Rescued 11 rows (including '바우세실', '모닝 레나', '글로비스심포니', '스파리겔', '이에스로즈') with only 1 break, yielding Net Gain +10 rows (+2.9289%p weighted gain).
- ko_map OFF: Rescued 7 rows with 0 breaks, yielding Net Gain +7 rows (+2.0502%p weighted gain).
Inference latency overhead is only ~1.3 ms/row (51.5s vs 48.0s for 2,372 rows), virtually negligible compared to heavy LLMs.
interpretations: Continuous phonetic embedding space provides dramatic resilience against phonetic variations and OCR/typing noise compared to discrete n-gram lookups.
The dense similarity bonus cleanly elevates true phonetic matches into Rank 1 when lexical similarity scores degrade due to character mutations.
limitations: 1 break occurred in severe noise ('바우 세실' -> VESSEL_43219), where extreme noise corrupted phonetic similarity beyond threshold.
Currently uses fixed dense_weight=2.5. Stage-2 CatBoost / GBDT classifier can learn optimal non-linear weighting.
decision: Officially validate DPR-Hybrid as superior to Baseline AS-06 in robustness and phonetic generalizability. Proceed with 5-fold cross-validation and packaging.
next_actions: Export full catalog embeddings for full dataset model
